AMENDMENT

3/2/2026 – The questions and presentations from Industry Day, 18 FEB 2026 have been posted.  The recording is forthcoming within the next couple weeks.

The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Panama City Division (NSWC PCD) is sponsoring its 2026 Industry Day on Wednesday, 18 February 2026, 0900-1200 CST.  The use of Microsoft Teams shall not be construed as a Government endorsement of the product.

The mission of NSWC, Panama City Division is to conduct research, development, test and evaluation, and in-service support of mine warfare systems, mines, naval special warfare systems, diving and life support systems, amphibious and expeditionary maneuver warfare systems, and other missions that occur primarily in coastal (littoral) regions, and execute other responsibilities as assigned by Commander, Naval Surface Warfare Center.
